spot_dir = '/home/nicholas/photographs/vacations/maui/'
spot = spot_dir.rstrip('/').split('/')[-1]
compressed_path = f"~/photographs/vacations/{spot}.zip"
res = apis.file_system.compress_directory(directory_path=spot_dir, access_token=fs_token, compressed_file_path=compressed_path)
print(res)

# Proceed to compress remaining vacation spot sub-directories and then delete all of them.
# Assumes fs_token and vac_dirs were created earlier; if not, log in again.

if 'fs_token' not in globals() or not fs_token:
    fs_pw = [x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='file_system'][0]
    fs_token = apis.file_system.login(username='nicholas.weber@gmail.com', password=fs_pw)['access_token']

if 'vac_dirs' not in globals() or not vac_dirs:
    vac_dirs = apis.file_system.show_directory(directory_path='~/photographs/vacations/', access_token=fs_token, entry_type='directories', recursive=False)

print('vac_dirs', vac_dirs)

# Compress stockholm and tokyo (and re-compress others only if their zip doesn't exist)
def spot_from_path(p):
    return p.rstrip('/').split('/')[-1]

def zip_path_for_spot(spot):
    return f"~/photographs/vacations/{spot}.zip"

# Only check existence for each target zip before compressing.
for d in vac_dirs:
    spot = spot_from_path(d)
    zp = zip_path_for_spot(spot)
    exists = apis.file_system.file_exists(file_path=zp, access_token=fs_token)['exists']
    print('spot', spot, 'zip', zp, 'exists', exists)
    if not exists:
        res = apis.file_system.compress_directory(directory_path=d, access_token=fs_token, compressed_file_path=zp, overwrite=False)
        print('compress', spot, res)

# Delete all vacation spot directories
for d in vac_dirs:
    res = apis.file_system.delete_directory(directory_path=d, access_token=fs_token)
    print('delete', d, res)

# Single verification pass: ensure each expected zip exists and no vacation sub-directories remain.
expected_spots = ['athens','maui','stockholm','tokyo']

vac_all = apis.file_system.show_directory(directory_path='~/photographs/vacations/', access_token=fs_token, entry_type='all', recursive=False)
vac_dirs = apis.file_system.show_directory(directory_path='~/photographs/vacations/', access_token=fs_token, entry_type='directories', recursive=False)
vac_files = apis.file_system.show_directory(directory_path='~/photographs/vacations/', access_token=fs_token, entry_type='files', recursive=False)

print('vac_all', vac_all)
print('vac_dirs', vac_dirs)
print('vac_files', vac_files)

zip_files = set([f.rstrip('/').split('/')[-1] for f in vac_files if f.endswith('.zip')])
expected_zip_files = set([s + '.zip' for s in expected_spots])

print('zip_files', sorted(zip_files))
print('expected_zip_files', sorted(expected_zip_files))
print('missing_zips', sorted(expected_zip_files - zip_files))
print('extra_zips', sorted(zip_files - expected_zip_files))
print('num_vac_dirs', len(vac_dirs))
